corrections.why: A photo dated 30 September 2011 shows a tower at these coordinates, and the county table marks a tower here as standing. The Forest Fire Lookout Association still lists the site as gone, with no date.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county table marks a tower Standing and a 2011 photo shows one, while the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the site gone. Status is left unresolved and all three are reported in the story.
The county table gives a 1952 move from a Morrison County site (Goose Lake). The Commons photo description gives 1955 or 1956 from Camp Ripley Military Reservation. Both are reported as claims.
The table lists 100 feet for the stair tower and its 1952 survey note says about 80 feet. No height is recorded in facts.

notes_for_editor: The county table covers two towers at this site. The 1958 Bankton move is also in the existing us-mn-bankton story. The 2011 standing tower is most likely the stair tower (No. 14), since No. 103 went to Bankton, but no source says so; the story does not make that link. The photo is already in the photo manifest, so no new photo is listed. Current condition and access are not found in any source.
